notes.note: Corrects the earlier note on ExistingSetupImportStepper: the shared formatBytes adds a TB step, so the setup stepper's output is not byte-identical for values of 1 TiB and up (1099511627776 now renders 1.0 TB instead of 1024.0 GB). The change is intentional; values below 1 TiB render as before. No documented claim in module-map.md describes the unit step.
